description:
*Doggy-younger man Nam-Hyeok X Grumpy older man Ho-Su.*

Ho-Su, a returning student who had always been lucky no matter what he did, ends up spending a night with Nam-Hyeok, a freshman he met at a drinking party, while drunk. However, he was only satisfied with the amazing relationship for a moment, and when a shining pattern appeared on Ho-Su's stomach, Nam-Hyeok screamed as if he fainted...

 *"I, I think I accidentally put a curse on my senior!"*

It was shocking that the person he spent a night with turned out to be a witch, but isn't it a bit strange that the way to lift the curse is to receive the witch's semen periodically? Wait, is this really effective?! 

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
